name: drag/indicator
why: UX-B-06 + UX-B-07 — the insertion line at the computed drop position, drawn ABOVE the first row. That position is the whole point: PagesTab.css:319 already has .bd-pg-drop-indicator.show and nothing adds the class (PageList.tsx:155, :351), and PageList.tsx:313-315 always inserts AFTER a target so the first slot is unreachable — while PageManager.reorderPage:342 already accepts afterId === null. CLONED FROM A HAIRLINE RULE, so it arrives border-grey: its fill must be set to the accent by hand, because I never read a fill on this file and cloning is the only way I can match a style without guessing a hex.

text: UX-B-06 / UX-B-07 — the line shows where the drop lands, and where it lands depends on which half of the row the pointer is in: above the midpoint inserts BEFORE. That is the only way the first slot becomes reachable, and on a site where nobody chose a homepage the first slot is the homepage. Today dragover sets only dropEffect (PageRow.tsx:115-119), so a drag shows the user nothing at all.

name: pub/state
why: UX-B-05 — on a site where nobody has chosen a homepage the root is whichever row is first, and no row says so. PageManager.ts:243 is the only writer of isHome, createPage (:61-93) never sets it, and PageRow.tsx:231 draws the roof glyph only when page.isHome — so the panel looks like a site with no homepage while ExportEngine.ts:146 quietly serves pages[0]. Until isHome is flagged at creation, the row that is ACTING as home carries the qualifier, so reorder and delete can warn before the root moves.
